chunks: And from him, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah who said:

I said to Zurara, 'Some people have narrated to me from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) various matters regarding the fixed shares (of inheritance), so I will present them to you. Whatever of them is false, say,

key_terms.زُرَارَة: Zurara ibn A'yan, a prominent Imamite scholar

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on inheritance for the husband and two parents according to Zurara?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the methodology of hadith verification (takhrij) in Shia scholarship, where a trusted narrator like Zurara validates reports against the teachings of the Imams. It specifically confirms the inheritance share of the husband and parents, resolving potential discrepancies in transmitted narrations by affirming the authenticity of Muhammad ibn Muslim's report. This underscores the importance of cross-referencing multiple chains of transmission to ensure doctrinal accuracy in legal matters.

en.hubeali: And from him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina who said,

‘I said to Zurara, ‘The people are narrating to me from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> with things regarding the Obligations (legislated shares of inheritance), so I present these to you. So whatever was false from it, so say, ‘This is false’; and whatever was true from it, so say, ‘This is true’, and do not report it and remain silent’. So I narrated to him with what had been narrated to me by Muhammad Bin Muslim regarding the husband and the two parents. He said, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, this is true!’
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ’Udhaynah who has narrated the following: “

I once said to Zurarah that certain people narrated to me from abu Ja‘far and abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, about certain things of ordained shares. I like to show them to you so you can tell me what is right and what is false; and about what is right, say that it is right but do not narrate and remain quiet, and I narrated to him what Muhammad ibn Muslim had narrated to me about husband and both parents. He said, ‘By Allah it is the truth.’”
